title: Public fields on CachedCrl/CachedOcspResponse lock storage repr
description: Public Vec<u8>/String fields on cache types lock the storage representation. Old: PKIX-f1j4.28
close_reason: CachedCrl and CachedOcspResponse fields are private behind new() and accessors, freeing the storage representation. Key types deliberately keep public fields -- an out-of-process implementation must read them to build its own key, and accessors would buy no representation freedom since the identity tuple is breaking to change either way; that asymmetry is now documented. cache.rs's unit tests are a child module and could reach the private fields, so tests/cache_public_api.rs implements a RevocationCache over a flat bytes-and-numbers store using only exported API; the OCSP fixture sets producedAt and thisUpdate 100s apart so a swapped accessor cannot pass. Commit a4b6668b.
